device.category: two-channel analogue percussion synthesizer, desktop or 80 HP Eurorack

architecture.summary: Two identical channels. Each has two oscillators set by a six-position mode switch (single, FM, mix, velocity-swept mix, FM plus noise, noise only), a pitch sweep up or down with speed and range, an LFO (square or triangle, 0.4-50 Hz) with sample and hold, a low-pass filter (WIDTH), a decay from 6 ms to 2.5 s and an output level. Triggered by pads or pulses at the rear, the panel buttons, or MIDI in two modes.

modules.name: MIDI
modules.description: Mode 1: notes 36 and 38 trigger channels 1 and 2 on one channel. Mode 2: each channel on its own MIDI channel, pitched by notes 21-84. CC 80/81 set decay.

modules.name: Mute
modules.description: Footswitch input that cuts off the decay on both channels.

modules.name: Channel 1 trigger
modules.description: Trigger from the TRIGGER jack (with SENSE threshold), the panel button, or MIDI; also measures trigger strength.

modules.name: Channel 1 noise
modules.description: White noise for modes E and F (the original's is fairly soft).

modules.name: Channel 1 tune
modules.description: TUNE fader and fine knob plus the TUNE jack and MIDI pitch: sets both oscillators and the filter cutoff together.

modules.name: Channel 1 oscillator 1
modules.description: Oscillator 1: heard alone in mode A, mixed in C and D, and the FM modulator in B and E.

modules.name: Channel 1 oscillator 2
modules.description: Oscillator 2: the frequency-modulated output in B and E, mixed in C and D. Its interval to oscillator 1 is fixed by an internal trimmer.

properties.interval: fixed by trimmer; not user adjustable on the original

modules.name: Channel 1 source mix
modules.description: Combines oscillators and noise according to OSC MODE.

modules.name: Channel 1 sweep
modules.description: Pitch sweep on each trigger, up or down, at SWEEP SPEED over SWEEP RANGE; in mode D its depth follows trigger strength.

modules.name: Channel 1 LFO
modules.description: Square or triangle LFO, 0.4-50 Hz, or off; also clocks the sample and hold.

modules.name: Channel 1 sample and hold
modules.description: Random steps on pitch at the LFO rate, even with the LFO wave switched off.

modules.name: Channel 1 filter
modules.description: Low-pass filter. Cutoff follows TUNE; the decay envelope sweeps it down from high, over a range set by WIDTH.

modules.name: Channel 1 decay
modules.description: Decay-only envelope (envelope 2 on the original), 6 ms to 2.5 s depending on tuning; its level follows trigger strength. Drives the VCA, the filter and, in mode D, oscillator 2's pitch.

modules.name: Channel 1 VCA
modules.description: Shapes the channel with its decay; OUTPUT sets the level.

behaviours.name: Oscillator modes
behaviours.rule: A: oscillator 1 alone, the classic drum-synth sweep. B: oscillator 1 frequency-modulates oscillator 2, which is heard; metallic. C: both mixed, oscillator 1 lower; vibraphone-like. D: both mixed; soft or hard hits sweep low to high, independent of SWEEP SPEED and RANGE (the sweep moves oscillator 1, the decay envelope oscillator 2). E: FM as B plus noise; struck thin metal. F: noise only. Both channels at once (A plus F) give an 808-style snare.

behaviours.name: Pitch sweep
behaviours.rule: Each trigger sweeps the pitch up or down at SWEEP SPEED over SWEEP RANGE: the classic synth-tom and laser sounds. OFF holds the tuned pitch.

behaviours.name: LFO and sample and hold
behaviours.rule: The LFO (square or triangle) modulates at LFO DEPTH. S&H adds random steps at the LFO SPEED rate, and keeps working with the LFO wave switched off.

behaviours.name: Decay, filter and dynamics
behaviours.rule: One decay envelope shapes the VCA and sweeps the filter down from high over the WIDTH range; TUNE moves the oscillators and filter cutoff together. Trigger strength sets the envelope level, so hard hits are louder and brighter. Decay runs from 6 ms to 2.5 s depending on tuning; MUTE cuts it off.

behaviours.name: Fixed oscillator interval
behaviours.rule: The interval between the two oscillators is set by an internal trimmer (originally 440 and 450 Hz), not by a panel control.

behaviours.name: MIDI modes
behaviours.rule: Mode 1: one MIDI channel; note 36 triggers channel 1, note 38 channel 2; pitch from the panel only. Mode 2: channel 1 on the set MIDI channel, channel 2 on the next one up; notes 21-84 set pitch (clamped outside). Both modes: CC 80 and 81 set decay. Chosen in SynthTribe or by holding a TRIG button at power-up; remembered.

behaviours.name: Trigger sensitivity
behaviours.rule: SENSE sets the trigger threshold for pads and other external sources to avoid false triggers.

source_inconsistencies: The Behringer specifications list '2 VCO' for two channels; the Pearl manual and schematic-based sources confirm two oscillators per channel (four in all).
The Behringer guide says WIDTH sets filter cutoff; the Pearl manual says it sets the range of a falling filter sweep, with cutoff following TUNE.
The Pearl text says the sweep's 'DEPTH control tracks the TUNE control'; there is no sweep DEPTH, so this means RANGE.
Mode B is described in both manuals as one oscillator modulating the other; the schematic-based Bergfotron notes give oscillator 1 modulating oscillator 2, which is heard.
The MIDI CHANNEL dipswitch is callout 42, but the MIDI operation text calls it 'dipswitch 43' (MIDI THRU).
Mode 2's channel rule says channel 2 follows on the next MIDI channel up, yet at 16 it drops to 15.

modelling_gaps.detail: Routing follows the Pearl manual and schematic-based notes; the Behringer guide does not contradict it, but a hands-on check would confirm Behringer kept it.
The Pearl original is modelled in pearl-syncussion-sy-1_synth.json from the same base.
